newsitem.title: USA: CareMatrix files for 31.25 mln common.
newsitem.headline: CareMatrix files for 31.25 mln common.

text.p: CareMatrix Corp, formerly known as Standish Care Co, filed Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to 31.25 million common shares.

The Needham, Mass.,.-based assisted living services company said its chairman and principal shareholder, Abraham Gosman, may sell up to 4,687,500 common shares if underwriters for the offering exercise their over-allotment options.
The offering is estimated to raise $143.75 million if all 35,937,500 shares were sold at an estimated $4.00 a share, according to the filing.

CareMatrix said it will use net proceeds to finance future acquisitions and development, repay debt, redeem preferrred stock held by the principal shareholder, pay dividends on series A preferred stock and for working capital purposes.
The offering will be made through a group of underwriters led by Dean Witter Reynolds Inc.

Gosman's stake will be reduced to 44.3 percent or 37,759,039 common shares after the offering, assuming the underwriters' over-allotment options are exercised. He currently holds a 78.6 percent stake or 42,446,539 common shares.
